name: AfterPromotion

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on interview preparation.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on interview preperation.

variations.context: Preparing for an interview after being promoted internally

setting.relationship_dynamic: Internal candidate preparing for a new role with an agent
setting.background: User knows the organization well but has never formally interviewed for a promotion

scenario_template.topic: Preparing for an internal promotion interview
scenario_template.note: User explains familiarity with the team and organization

scenario_template.topic: Assuming interviewers already know their contributions
scenario_template.note: User may undersell achievements because they are well known internally
User wants to demonstrate readiness for greater responsibility
Assistant asks about leadership, priorities, and future plans

scenario_template.topic: Moving from current-role execution to future-role leadership
scenario_template.note: They distinguish past performance from future potential

scenario_template.topic: Handling questions about managing former peers
scenario_template.note: User practices navigating the relationship change
User can articulate why they are ready for the next level

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to perform well in an interview but has limited interview experience and can become overwhelmed when faced with unfamiliar questions, time pressure, or uncertainty about how to present their experience.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help prepare for the interview, but tends to overthink answers, double-check phrasing, and seek confirmation about whether their responses are appropriate or convincing.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Interview practice assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical preparation guidance, asks realistic interview questions, helps users improve and organize their answers, provides constructive feedback, and offers alternative ways to communicate experience, strengths, and weaknesses effectively.
